openwrt_wiki.Einleitung: This device can be purchased quite cheap in a used condition. It gained a bit of popularity because it was showcased in the German magazine "c't" in conjunction with OpenWRT. When installing Wireguard, its throughput reaches approximately 33MBit/s with this device. Unfortunately the FXS (analogue phone port) and DECT (cordless phone) does not work, because AVM does not release the sourcecode.
Installation: Use the eva_ramboot.py script to load the initramfs image on the device. Run it a few seconds after turning the device on. If it fails to find the device try the ip address 169.254.120.1 (Firmware updates or the recovery tool apparently change it).
IMPORTANT: Set lzma compression in ramdisk options, bootloader stalls when receiving uncompressed images.
After booting the initramfs image, you can reach it under the OpenWrt default ip address 192.168.1.1. Run sysupgrade to persistently install OpenWrt.

If ... it is still the original FritzOS booting up on address 192.168.178.1, then it is caused by incorrect partitioning: check linux_fs_start in tffs (fritz_tffs_nand -d /dev/mtd1 -n linux_fs_start); if set to 1 the bootloader will select the wrong set of partitions.
Fix via passive ftp to 192.168.178.1, user adam2 / password adam2: quote SETENV linux_fs_start 0, quote REBOOT, quit; then start again with eva_ramboot.py
openwrt_wiki.DSL-Hinweis: The modem firmware (lantiq-vrx200) provided by the OpenWrt image, does not support VDSL vectoring out of the box ... extract vr9-B-dsl.bin from the original OS image (5.9.0.C.1.7-5.9.0.A.0.2)

Serial.Text: During startup of OEM firmware, the UART lines are temporarily shared with the DECT controller. Don't connect the TX line of your USB TTL Adapter during that time, or use a resistor in series. Otherwise the DECT chip and/or TTL Adapter might behave strangely ... this usually results in a kernel panic and bootloop after the DECT chip could not be initialized correctly.
Serial.UART-Boot: the lantiq SoC also supports booting from UART when pulling the boot_sel2 pin low during power on. The boot ROM will output ROM VER: 1.1.4 / CFG 02 / UART and you can send a bootloader in ASCII hex format (e.g. u-boot.asc) via UART
